caption:
Google just updated its rules so that connecting your Gmail or Photos to AI features can open the door to targeted ads based on that private data. Nothing says a smart assistant like your emails secretly setting up your next shopping ad. Would you trade your data privacy for a better AI recommendation? 🤖💡

@google

Source: The Verge

#Google #DataPrivacy #AIFeatures #TechNews #Marketing

post.news: Google updated its privacy policy to let personalized ads use data from Gmail, Drive, and Photos if you use its AI features.
post.take: We wanted a personal assistant, not a guy reading our emails to sell us running shoes.
post.insight: AI features are free because your personal memories and messages are the real product being monetised.
